title: CBN Madhya Pradesh Unit busts high-tech MD manufacturing lab in Pune; Two masterminds arrested from Ujjain and Jodhpur under multi-city ‘Operation Vajra’
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Finance

CBN Madhya Pradesh Unit busts high-tech MD manufacturing lab in Pune; Two masterminds arrested from Ujjain and Jodhpur under multi-city ‘Operation Vajra’

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
13 JUL 2026 8:21PM by PIB Delhi

In a major breakthrough against interstate synthetic drug trafficking syndicate, the
Central Bureau of Narcotics (CBN), Madhya Pradesh Unit
 has dismantled a sophisticated
Mephedrone (MD) manufacturing laboratory
 in Pune, Maharashtra, and arrested the two chief conspirators of the syndicate from
Ujjain (Madhya Pradesh)
 and
Jodhpur (Rajasthan)
 under
Operation
Vajra
.

The operation was carried out by the
Preventive Branch, Office of the Deputy Narcotics Commissioner, CBN, Neemuch
, on the basis of specific intelligence. The investigation and coordinated operations were conducted between
1
st
-10
th
 July 2026
.

During the operation, officers of CBN seized a high-tech illicit MD manufacturing laboratory in Pune along with sophisticated machinery, laboratory equipment, precursor chemicals and safety gear used for manufacturing synthetic drugs. Two accused, including the chief conspirators, were arrested under the NDPS Act, 1985.

The operation is a continuation of the investigation initiated in
February 2026
, when CBN Neemuch intercepted a passenger bus at
Mandsaur
 and seized
8.17 kg Mephedrone
. Subsequent searches led to the detection of an illicit laboratory at
Thavlay, Mhow
, resulting in the seizure of
43.82 kg Mephedrone
,
261.32 kg precursor chemicals
, and advanced manufacturing equipments.

Based on sustained intelligence and extensive interstate investigation, the Preventive Team tracked the absconding mastermind, who had been continuously changing locations across several states using forged identity documents. After an intensive undercover operation, the accused was successfully arrested from
Ujjain
 during the late-night hours of
3
rd

July 2026
 with
valuable assistance from the Ujjain (M.P.) Police
.

During the extensive investigation it was revealed that the syndicate had established another sophisticated MD manufacturing facility in
Diggi, Bhosri, Pune
, financed and coordinated by a co-conspirator based in
Jodhpur
. Acting swiftly, CBN teams carried out synchronised searches on the late night of
9
th
 July 2026
 in Pune and Jodhpur simultaneously, arresting the second conspirator and dismantling the clandestine laboratory. Sophisticated digital machinery, laboratory equipment, heavy glassware, precursor chemicals and safety gear were seized during the operation. All seized machinery, equipment and chemicals have been taken into possession under the provisions of the
NDPS Act, 1985
. Further investigation is in progress.

The
Central Bureau of Narcotics (CBN)
 is a regulatory and law enforcement agency under the Ministry of Finance that supervises the legal cultivation of opium poppy, procures the harvest from licensed farmers, and regulates the international trade of psychotropic substances and precursor chemicals. Headquartered in Gwalior, the CBN balances this strict regulatory oversight with active drug enforcement, investigating narcotics offenses and seizing illicit drugs and assets under the NDPS Act to prevent trafficking and substance abuse.

During the current calendar year, the
CBN,
has registered
142 cases
 and effected
193 arrests including busting of four clandestine labs
. Through such sustained enforcement actions, CBN continues to demonstrate its unwavering commitment towards dismantling organised drug trafficking networks and achieving the national vision of a
Drug-Free India (
Nasha Mukt Bharat
).
